idea-plugin.name: Piwi
idea-plugin.description:
Your Playwright suite's history, from a Piwi instance, at the line you are editing. Piwi keeps every run CI throws away, groups the failures by root cause and finds the locator you should have used; this plugin brings that to WebStorm, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and Rider.

What it shows

  • The latest CI failures at their lines. Each failure of the latest run on your branch is an error at the line that failed, with the reason, the screenshot and the trace one action away. A run you make locally lays over it the moment it ends: a test you fixed leaves, one you broke joins.
  • The heal as a quick fix. On a broken locator, the replacement Piwi recommends from the last passing run is an Alt+Enter away: the same edit an auto-heal pull request would make.
  • The Piwi tool window. The run's failures as a tree, grouped by file, cluster or owner, with your runs since; each test re-runs, opens its trace or its page in one click. Compare with another branch, a run by its id, or your local runs only.
  • The tests behind each line. Each test's latest result in the gutter, a failing test's body tinted, and above each locator line and each application file the tests that use or reach it, ready to run.
  • Coverage marks. With coverage recorded, the lines your tests ran, in TypeScript, JavaScript and C# alike, the tests behind each function, and the lines changed since the coverage run.
  • Brittle locators and breaking changes. A warning on a locator that will not survive a restyle, and on an unsaved change that renames a string your tests find elements by, each with a quick fix.
  • Tests recorded at the caret. Record Here opens a browser through your project's own Playwright and writes what you do there into the test, calling your page objects when connected. No instance needed.
  • The status bar. The latest run, the run you started as it runs, and what it changed once it ended.

Connect

The plugin reads the connection the Piwi reporter already uses (the environment, the workspace .env or the Piwi desktop app). Otherwise, Settings → Tools → Piwi signs you in with the browser. Paths clicked in the dashboard open at their line in the IDE, and locators picked in the Piwi Picker browser extension land at the caret. Piwi's MCP server is one copy away for the AI Assistant.

Works in WebStorm, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, Rider and the other JetBrains IDEs with the LSP API and JavaScript support, from 2024.1, with Node.js 20 or later. Documentation: piwitests.dev/features/editors.
